title: Associated primes of a flat tensor lie in the corresponding residue-field fibre
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, with $R$ and $S$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $P$ be a finite $S$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For every finite $R$-module $Q$ and every prime $\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Ass}_S(Q\otimes_R P)$, put $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak q\cap R$. Then $\mathfrak q$ is an associated prime of the fibre module $P\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, regarded as an $S$-module through its canonical action; equivalently, under the standard identification of primes of $S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ with primes of $S$ lying over $\mathfrak p$, it belongs to $\operatorname{Ass}_{S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)}(P\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p))$. Here associated primes are annihilators of elements [def-weil-pbc-annihilator-associated-primes], and $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is the residue field [def-weil-residue-field]. Tensor products are [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product].
